I want you to act as an SEO content strategist who writes fluent [TARGETLANGUAGE]. Create a detailed outline for an article about [PROMPT]. Use H2 and H3 headings, add a short note under each heading saying what it should cover, suggest five long-tail keywords, and finish with a meta description of no more than 155 characters. Do not write the article itself, only the outline.

My instructions for your answer: keep it plain and skip the preamble.
